reviews.text: Tara and her team are AMAZING! Always professional and helpful. They have been serving our pool for 3 years now and we’re new to owning a pool. She and the team have explained things to us helped us with repairs and walked us through all our questions and concerns with grace. I highly recommend Backyard Blues to all my family and friends with pools!
reviews.author: Sunshine Mermaid

reviews.text: Backyard Blues is hands-down the best pool service company I’ve ever worked with. They don’t just clean the pool and leave — they really care about their customers and go the extra mile to make sure everything is perfect. They’re always reliable, professional, and willing to explain things so I know exactly what’s going on with my pool. On top of that, they always bring treats for my dog, Bryant, which says so much about the kind of people they are. It’s rare to find a company that takes this much pride in their work and treats their customers like family. I couldn’t be happier and highly recommend Backyard Blues to anyone looking for top-notch pool service!
reviews.author: Bob Coleman

reviews.text: Backyard Blues is more than just a pool service; they're pool partners. They take the stress out of pool ownership, allowing me to truly enjoy my sparkling oasis. If you're looking for a dependable, knowledgeable, and communicative pool service, look no further. You won't be disappointed!
reviews.author: Vicki Burlew

reviews.text: Backyard Blues replaced my filter and motor. Im very happy. I've needed an upgrade for awhile and Tara made it happen. The price She quoted was reasonable and she is very professional. If I could give more stars I would. 😁
reviews.author: sheryl miscavage

reviews.text: Had a booster pump that went out along with a timer, called to schedule a service call and they were out there within a couple of days. Had to order the parts and they were at my house the very next day to install them. Great job, highly recommend!
reviews.author: Jason Cech

reviews.text: I highly recommend this company! Tara is very helpful and friendly. I will definitely be using them for all of our pool needs.
reviews.author: Valarie Ricketts

reviews.text:
Tara’s team holds high standards and professionalism! Friendliness and cleanliness is their forte.
Anytime there is an issue one of any of the techs is ready and patient to Jehle work with you to keep your pool running efficient and clean. I couldn’t recommend any other company to do the job!
reviews.author: Hold ya Horses

reviews.text: Tara and her team are fantastic!! She is extremely knowledgeable, trustworthy, and takes care of our pool as if it were her own pool. I'm a local Real Estate Agent which has dealt with multiple pool companies and I am very pleased with the service received from Tara & Her Team. When we first moved in our house in 2021, the PH of our pool was extremely out of control. Thanks to Tara, the pool was ready for use in a short amount of time. If you are looking for a great pool company, you just found it!! Don't hesitate reaching out to them
reviews.author: Brandon Stewart
